title: Decode: MegaMoE NVFP4 EP32 + shared-expert overlap
shape: D3-32 r24: 96 requests / DP rank (384 verify rows), SP shard = 96 MoE tokens per GPU, 28 local experts, top-16, L~135K, k=3
basis: baseline: coordinator seed (gap512 EP16 B92 moved to EP32). achievable: model rows at EP32 T=96 tokens/GPU: MegaMoE 37.0 us/layer (ops + P11/P12; moe_ep32 t_ach interp T64/T128) x 92 = 3.40 ms + shared experts MXFP8 0.95 ms (optables nvfp4 D3-32 r8/r32 interp) = 4.35 ms. Measured FI a368c5f66 1-GPU (28 experts, no comm) T96 = 48.9 us/layer.
gap_analysis: MEASURED 1-GPU EP32-shape emulation (FI a368c5f66, 28 local experts, random top-16, NVFP4, CUDA graph x10, no NVLink): per layer 34.7 / 43.7 / 45.1 / 48.9 / 52.3 us at T 1/4/32/96/128. Per call at T96: main persistent kernel 43.7 us, router kernel 3.5, separate BF16 top-k reduce 2.7, NVFP4 quant+stage 1.9 (partly PDL-overlapped). Hecate EP32 (same kernel, 32 GPUs) adds ~17 us of dispatch/combine at T64-T128 (62.8/69.1 us). The weight stream itself is not the limit: going from ~13 active experts (T1) to 28 (T96) adds ~13 us for ~2x the bytes, i.e. the marginal stream runs near the die-local HBM rate, while ~18-20 us per call is fixed overhead inside the main kernel even with no comm (startup, sizes-ready wait, FC1->FC2 per-expert dependency tail, combine/finalize), plus ~5-8 us in the 3 side kernels. So the gap to the model (37 us/layer incl. comm) = fixed in-kernel latency (~18 us) + comm latency not overlapped with the weight stream (~17 us) + side kernels. Profilers: ncu not found in the image on PATH (probing).
inefficiencies: MEASURED: ~18-20 us/call fixed latency inside the persistent MegaMoE kernel at the EP32 per-GPU shape even without NVLink (T1 30.7 us kernel vs T96 43.7 us)
MEASURED: dispatch/combine latency at EP32 ~17 us/call on top (EP32 66 vs 1-GPU 49 us at T96), not hidden behind the weight stream
MEASURED: 3 side kernels per call (router 3.5, top-k reduce 2.7, quant/stage 1.9 us at T96)
HYPOTHESIS: weight streaming waits for sizes_ready (scheduler gate) although at T>=4 every local expert is active -> weight prefetch could start at kernel entry
